meta.name: faceless-explainer
meta.description: Turn arbitrary text — an article, notes, a topic, a brief — into a faceless explainer video: there is no site or footage to capture, so the visuals are invented per scene (typography, abstract graphics, diagrams, data-viz). Use for topic explainers, concept breakdowns, how-tos, listicles. Not a video built from a website (/product-launch-video — promo or tour). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把文章、笔记或选题变成无真人出镜的讲解视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想把现成文字快速做成讲解视频,又不想出镜或拍摄。
copy.tagline_en: Turn text, notes, or a topic into a faceless explainer video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want explainer videos from written text without filming yourself.

howto.what: 把你给的文章、笔记或一个话题等任意文字，做成无真人出镜的解说视频：选设计预设、写分镜和脚本、生成配音与配乐、逐帧做画面，最后渲染出 mp4。其中几步会先请你确认。
howto.when: 当你要求就某个话题、概念或做法做解说，或把一段文字转成解说视频时接管。若视频要基于网站做产品或宣传，则走 /product-launch-video；意图不明则走 /hyperframes。

say.text: 把这篇讲复利的文章做成无真人出镜的解说视频
say.note: 会先把分镜方案给你过目确认

say.text: 用这个设计预设，时长大概控制在两分钟
say.note: 时长先按 brief 里的长度定，再按实际情况报告
会以 --voice 传入对应的音色 id

howto.what_en: Claude turns text (an article, notes, a topic, a brief) into a faceless explainer video: it picks a design preset, drafts a storyboard and script, generates narration and BGM, builds a frame per scene, and renders an mp4.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for a topic, concept or how-to explainer video from text. Videos built from a website or product promos go to /product-launch-video; if unclear, /hyperframes.

say_en.text: Turn this article on compound interest into a faceless explainer video
say_en.note: You see a storyboard to approve first

say_en.text: Use this design preset and keep it around two minutes
say_en.note: Length comes from the brief, then assembly reports the cut

say_en.text: Use a male voice for the narration
say_en.note: Passed as --voice with a provider-specific id
